title: World Cup: Houston NASA Space Center Ticket & Live Spanish Guide
blurb:
With this combo package, enjoy round-trip transportation and general admission tickets to Space Center Houston with your Spanish-speaking guide who will navigate your group through the Space Center's most noteworthy exhibits, presentation theaters, and the amazing "Rocket Park". 

During this 5 hour daily excursion, our expert guide will have you experiencing the Space Center like a true NASA All-Star including the amazing Independence Plaza, International Space Station, Life on Mars, Starship Gallery and tram tours! 

With so many amazing things including the Saturn V Rocket and Rocket Park, our expert guide can also take group photos for memories to last a lifetime!
